answer: In a Proof of Agent network, trust flows outward from an oasis of verified nodes. To resist Sybil attacks, random multi-agent auditor committees inspect topological cut verifications across the trust graph. If an attacker injects fake nodes to spoof quorum, isolating any suspect vertex requires a superlinear attacker cost in bonded capital. When fraudulent cuts are detected, game-theoretic slashing reduces their collateral to an inert relic.
